mentions.name: eyg.run
mentions.description: A programming language the author is building that for a long time had no syntax. It was developed alongside a structural editor worked on for a long time, and this weekend the sneaky text syntax that existed for testing was finally documented. The structural editor's future is uncertain, but the language remains fun to write and use.
